newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia Yee Lee in private placement.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia Yee Lee in private placement.

text.p: Malaysia's Yee Lee Corp Bhd said it is proposing a private placement of up to 3.47 million new shares representing 10 percent of its issued and paid-up share capital.
It said in a statement sent to the exchange late on Thursday that the issue price of the placement will be determined at a later date.
Proceeds from the placement will be used to finance the expansion of its business activities, reduce bank debt and provide additional working capital.
Yee Lee is involved in making cooking oil, margarine, shortening and other consumer products.

Upon completion of the placement and assuming the maximum options available under the employee share option scheme are exercised into 736,000 new shares prior to the placement, the issued and paid-up share capital of Yee Lee will rise from 34 million ringgit to 38.21 million ringgit, it said.
